clauses.heading: Indemnification
clauses.text_original: The Vendor shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the Client from and against any and all claims, damages and expenses, without limitation.
clauses.text_en: The Vendor shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the Client from and against any and all claims, damages and expenses, without limitation.

clauses.heading: Term and Termination
clauses.text_original: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for twelve (12) months, renewing automatically unless either party gives thirty (30) days notice.
clauses.text_en: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for twelve (12) months, renewing automatically unless either party gives thirty (30) days notice.
